SOCIAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   C. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   D. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

13. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
